ux_observations.observation: Job ended in 'timeout' status with no output URL generated, indicating a complete pipeline failure before video rendering could complete.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Investigate pipeline timeout thresholds and add checkpointing to identify which stage (rendering, encoding, upload) caused the hang. Implement pipeline stage monitoring with alerts at 50%, 75%, and 90% of max execution time.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA returned 'no result' — without a produced video, automated quality assessment could not run, leaving zero quality validation for this job.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Implement fallback QA logging that captures partial artifacts or last-known-good frame for forensic analysis even on failed jobs. Add a 'QA skipped: no output' distinct status versus 'QA failed'.

ux_observations.observation: Six add-ons activated simultaneously (captions, audio, branding, colorGrade, effects, layout) for a 'Post Everywhere' template — this heavy combination may contribute to processing timeouts.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Analyze job duration correlation with add-on count. Consider sequential processing for 4+ add-ons or implementing a complexity score that triggers extended timeout thresholds automatically.

ux_observations.observation: OPERATE tier users expect reliable, hands-off execution. A timeout with no output and no partial delivery represents a complete failure of the tier's value proposition.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Implement graceful degradation: if timeout is imminent, render a lower-fidelity version or skip non-essential add-ons (e.g., effects, colorGrade) to deliver something rather than nothing.

ux_observations.observation: No output URL means the user received nothing actionable — no video, no preview, no error artifact to troubleshoot.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Generate a failure summary asset (thumbnail + error report PDF or status page link) and deliver to output URL so users have immediate visibility into what went wrong without checking dashboards.
